results.error: PUT /admin/source-classifications/cyclingelectric.com as EDITOR and as READER: Expected 403 {"error":"ACCESS_DENIED"} — observed 400 {"error":"VALIDATION_ERROR","message":"sourceType: invalid value, accepted values are [JOURNALISM, CORPORATE, GOVERNMENT_NGO, AGGREGATOR, ACADEMIC, PRESS_RELEASE, SOCIAL_UGC, REVIEW_SITES, OTHER]"}. The request body is validated before the role is checked, so a non-admin gets a validation error instead of 403. Nothing was written (invalid body). A valid PUT was not sent, so whether a valid body from a non-admin would be refused could not be checked without risking a global write.
